Population.evidence_source: [page/5/Text/7] Selection criteria for participants included (a) being suicidal between the ages of 15 and 24; (b) having been suicidal within the past 3 years; (c) being free of suicidal thoughts and feelings for a minimum of 6 months prior to being interviewed; and (d) willingness to participate in research. [page/5/Text/8] Fifty participants, 41 females and 9 males, were included in the study. At the time of the interview, participants were between 15 and 27 years of age with a mean age of 21.
